lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible across the lateral flank, with higher density and smaller diameters observed towards the anterior region near the head.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Multiple vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a lattice-like structure across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the crests and low-intensity shadowing directly beneath.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, horizontally-oriented white linear mark, appearing as a surface abrasion or scar, is visible on the upper-left quadrant of the head region, anterior to the primary spot field.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of approximately 14 small, vertically-striped yellow fish (pilot fish) distributed in the immediate water column around the ventral and lateral regions of the shark.
